notes.title: Terminal 81R - 1.1.9 Patch Notes
notes.content:
-In the update uploaded 2 days ago, the dance minigame became broken because a bug in the code, in this update this bug has been solved and also the dance minigame key detection system was reworked, has a result, now you can dance using WASD or the arrow keys and the key detection is much more accurate
-Now you can dance in the Dance Therapy minigame in the field with the arrow keys as well

Thank you to all people playing Terminal 81R remember that you can report bugs in: https://discord.com/invite/AygFDaujxC

notes.title: Terminal 81R - 1.1.8 Patch Notes
notes.content:

notes.title: Terminal 81R - 1.1.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug that caused the rain to bug during the game credits.
-I am trying to fix a bug that happens to very few people, which caused the recolection/interaction with some objects in the game to completely broke and stop working in some parts of the game, sometimes in the asian restaurant, or in the supermarket, i added some fixes in this patch, however, this bug has been extremely challenging to properly address (i suspect the Unity engine could have some responsability), please if you encounter this bug, get in touch with me in my Discord server.

Thank you to all people playing Terminal 81R remember that you can report bugs in: https://discord.com/invite/AygFDaujxC
